notes.title: SUMMER SALES!!!
notes.content:
Hot deals!


Summer is in full swing, and that means it's the perfect time for an adventure!
An adventure with the visual novel SIGNAL: Uncharted Lands.
Meet funny doggos, explore Earth in a post-apocalyptic world, and uncover the secrets of this strange place!

And during the summer sale, adventures become even more accessible with a 33% discount from June 26 to July 10.
Don’t miss your chance to dive into an adventure with adorable companions!

notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS!
notes.content:
ACHIEVEMENTS HAVE BEEN ADDED TO THE GAME! 
The game will feature a total of 30 achievements.  
You can earn them through game progress or specific choices.  
The thirtieth and final achievement can only be unlocked by collecting all the previous ones! But will you be up to the challenge? The answer is not far away now!

notes.title: Dobby in real life
notes.content:
The character in the game and the original Dobby
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198561/8314fd5b446d78ea9c5e915fb399dd9b97836c31.jpg

Why is this little dog named Dobby?
It's  simple. I love the Harry Potter universe and books. And when Dobie (the dog) was a small puppy, his ears and eyes were disproportionately large compared to his head. And he  resembled the character of Dobby from the movie about Harry Potter. And he really likes to steal my socks ːsteamsadː

His clothes look familiar
So it is! There are a lot of references and easter eggs in our game. Dobby's outfit is also a reference to one great cartoon series. Which one? You have to guess it yourself ːsteammockingː


Does he really like veggie sausages?
And although Dobby eats regular meat dog food, he loves vegetables and fruits very much. Especially peas and pea sprouts ːsteamhappyː
